headline: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
summary: Virginia Governor Spanberger creates an AI task force. New executive order aims to curb data center development. It empowers local communities to have more say in approvals.

headline: Disney’s first CTO is Character.AI’s former CEO
summary: Disney appoints Karandeep Anand as its first-ever Chief Technology Officer. Anand previously served as CEO of Character.AI. He will report directly to Disney's executive leadership.

headline: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
summary: The iPhone 18 Pro features significant camera upgrades this year. It introduces a new variable aperture main lens. This allows for better low-light shots and improved depth of field.

headline: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom proposes an AI 'kill switch' mandate. An executive order aims for the state to lead in AI oversight. An expert group will provide recommendations within two months.

headline: New Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia After Being Mistaken for a Kitten
summary: A new wild cat species, Leopardus Tilcayo, was discovered in Bolivia. It had been previously mistaken for a kitten by its finder. The species is now known as the Tilcayo tiger cat.

headline: Helldivers Movie Eyes Reacher's Alan Ritchson as Its Star
summary: Alan Ritchson, star of 'Reacher,' is reportedly in talks for the Helldivers movie. PlayStation's upcoming film adaptation is actively seeking its lead. Ritchson is a strong contender for the starring role.

headline: For Today Only, Save $570 Off the Slim and Powerful Asus ROG Zephyrus G14 RTX 5080 Gaming Laptop
summary: Save $570 on the Asus ROG Zephyrus G14 gaming laptop today. The laptop features a powerful RTX 5080 graphics card. This limited-time deal offers a slim and powerful device.

headline: Mega Man: Dual Override Preview: We Played as Proto Man This Time
summary: A preview for 'Mega Man: Dual Override' highlights Proto Man gameplay. Proto Man offers a distinctly different challenge than Mega Man. Players select a character for the entire run, boosting replayability.

headline: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
summary: Earl Spencer defends claims about Prince Charles made in his new book. He asserts Charles said 'we'll forget her soon enough' regarding Diana. Spencer spoke with the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg about the controversy.

headline: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
summary: Earl Spencer alleges Prince Charles 'went ballistic' during a phone call. This incident occurred following Princess Diana's death. These claims were revealed in an exclusive BBC interview.

headline: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
summary: MI5 confirms it gave false evidence in court. The case involved defending a violent informant in a neo-Nazi probe. This marks the first time MI5 has admitted the BBC's revelation.

headline: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
summary: Flight disruptions were caused by a millisecond-long software defect. Over 2,000 flights were canceled due to the issue. Hundreds of thousands of passengers were affected by the chaos.
